summary: Fresh MenAbng MVP — backend fully validated via pytest (18/18 passing) covering auth, books/join, transactions+summary, accounts CRUD with balance, shopping planner lifecycle, profile rename, avatar type validation, file ownership check, and Google Drive status/export. Frontend register→home→catat (keypad)→save→home refresh verified end-to-end on 390x844 mobile viewport: new transaction (-Rp50.000 Transport) appears on home card and balance updates. All testIDs for login, register, home, catat (keypad/type/category/source/save), tabs, and belanja/profil/rekening are present. No red-screen errors, no deprecated expo packages (uses expo-router 6, expo-image-picker, no expo-av/barcode-scanner). CORS and JWT handling correct.

issues: Kategori row is a horizontal scrollable list — on 390px viewport only ~4 categories visible (Transport, Rumah, Kesehatan). Users can scroll but there is no visual affordance (chevron / fade) that indicates more categories exist to the right. Minor UX hint recommended.

At the WIB-midnight boundary, 'Masuk/Keluar hari ini' may read Rp0 while 'Total Tabungan' already reflects the new tx. This is a legitimate timezone edge (date flipped between save and summary refetch) — consider logging transaction date with explicit WIB conversion to be safe, otherwise it's cosmetic.

action_items: No code changes required. Optional polish: add a right-edge fade/chevron on Catat kategori scrollview so users discover makan/belanja/tagihan/hiburan/pendidikan/lainnya-out categories without needing to swipe blindly.
Optional: for 'today_in/today_out' robustness, include Asia/Jakarta timezone offset note in UI copy or ensure summary query uses the same reference moment as transaction create.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 697 lines — borderline over the 700-line soft cap. Consider splitting transactions/accounts/shopping routers into their own modules as the app grows.
Mongo _id leakage: all responses go through explicit *_out helpers that convert ObjectId→str and drop _id. Clean.
Env vars: all URLs/secrets sourced from process env; no hardcoded defaults for sensitive keys.
FastAPI deprecation warning: '@app.on_event' is deprecated — migrate to lifespan context manager in a future pass (non-blocking).
Google Drive routes are correctly gated behind GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET presence and return 503 cleanly in preview.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (register, catat keypad+save, home refresh, tab testIDs discovered; one tab-click timeout retried successfully in second run)

seed_data_creation: No seed data; tests create unique TEST_/ui_ prefixed users per run and soft-delete created plans/transactions where applicable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_menabng_api.py as regression. For frontend, the login screen's register link testID is 'login-to-register-link' (not 'login-link-to-register' as listed in the brief). Home tab testIDs: tabs-riwayat, tabs-belanja, tabs-profil. Catat categories 'makan', 'belanja' etc. are off-screen on 390px — scroll horizontally or pick 'transport' which is first visible when selecting kategori Keluar.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only cosmetic observations noted under design_issues.
